newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tennis - Rafter takes control against Damm in Davis Cup.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tennis - Rafter takes control against Damm in Davis Cup.

text.p: Australia's Pat Rafter has won the first two sets against Martin Damm of the Czech Republic in the opening rubber of the Davis Cup quarter-final.
But Damm fought back to take the third set 6-4 at Memorial Drive.
Rafter took only 26 minutes to snare the first set 6-1 before his opponent settled into the match.
The Australian number two snared the second set 7-6 after Damm wasted a set point during a tense tie-break.
